description: The Resolve status box shows raw value slugs ('review', 'completed') while every other surface uses labels ('Review', 'Completed'). Alternatives carry no time, so the person has to go to History to decide.
expected: Each alternative shows the label (e.g. 'Review'), the author and when it was saved, and the button names the value ('Keep Completed').
suggested_fix: Format conflict values through the same field formatter as the summary and History; add the alternative's timestamp; label buttons 'Keep {value}'.

description: Saving a conflicted field from Edit task, or handing off while status or assignee is conflicted, fails with 'Resolve the concurrent alternatives explicitly / Your last confirmed data remains available.' It is jargon, names no field and does not point to the Resolve box. Edit task and Hand off work stay enabled with no hint that they will fail.
expected: 'Status has two competing values. Choose one in Resolve status below first.' with a link or scroll to that box, or disable status editing in the form while it is conflicted.
suggested_fix: Map CONFLICT_REQUIRES_RESOLUTION to field-specific copy; disable the conflicted field in the editor and the handoff status with an inline explanation.

description: The board's 'Conflicting edits' label is small muted grey text, the same weight as the assignee line, although it marks a state that needs a person's decision.
expected: A visible warning treatment (amber, matching the Resolve box) on the card.
suggested_fix: Style the conflict label as a warning chip in the Resolve box's amber.

description: After Keep this status the clicked button is removed and focus falls to document.body.
expected: Focus moves to the restored Status select or the panel heading.
suggested_fix: After a successful resolve, focus the quick Status select (or the next Resolve section).
